descriptor: Before and after image comparison slider

voice.summary: Writes like a showroom guide who steps back and lets the picture speak. Short instructions, concrete scene names and a calm tone that never oversells the result.
dos: Tell the viewer how to interact in one sentence
Name scenes plainly, like Mountains or Living room
Keep labels to one or two words
donts: Do not use the word magic
Do not bury the instruction under hype

taglines: Drag to compare, stay for the detail
Slide the line, judge for yourself
Before and after, side by side
boilerplate: Splitframe is an image comparison component that lets visitors drag a divider, tap or use the keyboard to see a before and after side by side, in any scene.

microcopy.error: The image could not load. Please reload the scene.

logo.note: Two opposing chevrons mirror the handle that slides between before and after.
